meaningKo: 자신이 한 잘못이나 문제에 대해 사실을 받아들이다.
exampleEn: It's time to face the music and accept the consequences of your actions.
exampleKo: 이제는 잘못한 일의 결과를 받아들일 때가 됐어.
gameExamples: After realizing the mistake he made at work, he knew he had to face the music and explain it to his boss.
She couldn't avoid the situation any longer and decided it was best to face the music rather than run away from her problems.
When the team lost the match, they had to face the music and acknowledge their lack of preparation.
